justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Strong for chronic LBP; ATEAM RCT is high quality. Evidence outside MSK is sparse.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 1,600-hour training program over 3 years; among the highest investment per hours in allied health.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to chronic pain and movement dysfunction; very limited practitioner base reduces setting availability.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Minimal third-party coverage; primarily self-pay; some private pay integrative health practices offer it.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Very limited employer demand in clinical settings; primarily private practice and performing arts.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients who engage report transformative experience; requires significant commitment.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Performers, musicians, and chronic pain patients pay cash; niche but loyal clientele.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Rarity and 1:1 nature support solid hourly rates, though ceiling is limited.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Few PTs hold AmSAT certification — strong differentiator in performing arts medicine.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly personality- and skill-driven; difficult to scale beyond the practitioner.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Recognized in performing arts communities; limited mainstream consumer demand.
justifications.business.efficiency: 1,600-hour, 3-year training is among the most expensive and time-intensive in rehab.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Not recognized in PT/OT academic promotion structures.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Some BMJ-published RCTs (back pain, Parkinson's) but small research community.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Niche relevance to motor learning or performing arts content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: A few decent RCTs exist (notably ATEAM trial), better than many alt-therapies.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Not listed in academic job postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Enormous time investment for minimal academic payoff.
